text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
But of course! It's one of the Classic
races, and
the first battle in the Tiara
tour!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
choice_data_list: でもいつもと同じように？

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Don't get preoccupied with the race's
name.
Just run the whole thing without
straining myself.
Right?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm! Just leave it to me! I can do
anything I
put my mind to!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Okay, time to go. Don't overdo—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh nooo. All I did was turn it a little!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's still using even more strength than
usual.
But she's changed from last year.
This time, even
if she's running in a G1—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Waaagh... Wh-what do I do? Glue it
back on? Do
you have any superglue?
